release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.5 - Multi-Network Support & UI Enhancements:
- Implemented multi-network support for web app
- Fixed profile endpoint JWT token decoding issue
- Enhanced chat list with improved last message display
- Added timestamp below last message in chat tiles
- Auto-detection of API server based on access network IP
- Works seamlessly on multiple network interfaces (10.120.4.230 and 160.2.1.18)
- Fixed profile screen loading issue after server restart
- Improved chat tile layout and message preview visibility
- Enhanced error handling and connection management
